optimizedDescription.value: GetConfig returns construction-time structuredClone SpecdConfig snapshot; no disk I/O; not the live kernel wiring reference.

optimizedContext.value:
# GetConfig

## Rules
- Ctor accepts `SpecdConfig` same object as `createKernel`. Store `structuredClone(config)`. Live reference MUST NOT be returned from `execute()`.
- `execute()` no params. Returns `Readonly<SpecdConfig>` construction-time snapshot. Referentially identical across calls on same instance.
- MUST NOT read filesystem, `ConfigLoader`, or `ConfigWriter`. Disk `specd.yaml` changes require kernel recreate.
- Host-facing read API. Domain use cases MUST NOT re-inject full project config into other `execute` inputs. Persist config via `ConfigWriter` factories, not mutating returned object.
- Standalone `createGetConfig(config: SpecdConfig)` in `composition/use-cases/` without full kernel.
- Config factory via `resolveGetConfigDeps` (`config: SpecdConfig`) only.

## Constraints
- MUST NOT mutate internal snapshot after construction
- MUST NOT expose live SpecdConfig used by internal kernel wiring (e.g. ListWorkspaces)
